command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
EXPECTED_HTML=18770d8e333af1bc49a818da4dbd5c2e482b859e0142d0213df6c956184c931e
EXPECTED_DAEMON=5527a1510e4101bcd97a9f57317580638757485d929a9b8e68c3d0ea9d91fcd2
CAND=/var/tmp/go-avatar-eye-mask-shadow-v1
BACKUP=.go_backups/blink-relief2-pre-eye-only-20260912T0744
EVD=.go_evidence/blink-relief2-eye-only-live-20260912T0744
test "$(sha256sum buehne.html|awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_HTML"
test "$(sha256sum buehne_daemon.py|awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_DAEMON"
test -d augen_blink_relief2; test -d augen_blink_ai; test -d augen_blink
test "$(sha256sum "$CAND/eye_identity_mask.png"|awk '{print $1}')" = 321ef6fa09c6dfb72ab9eb486d623b49d5a4e9c512ace80bfd09ef4e7f3867b0
test "$(sha256sum "$CAND/eye_identity_open.png"|awk '{print $1}')" = 8ab1a11c6f8a738e34c516bbf65c00e0f48de70c7341bfa970f236e002c94fc9
test "$(sha256sum "$CAND/manifest.json"|awk '{print $1}')" = 2e16c2fb6f7ed3b204a093707492826dd81bd146677604f3c07430ff9db41d95
test "$(find "$CAND/blink" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'blink_*.png' | wc -l)" -eq 12
for f in augen_blink/blink_*.png; do n=$(basename "$f"); cmp -s "augen_blink/$n" "augen_blink_ai/$n"; cmp -s "augen_blink/$n" "augen_blink_relief2/$n"; done
echo PREIMAGE_TRIPLET_BYTE_IDENTICAL=PASS
mkdir -p .go_backups .go_evidence; test ! -e "$BACKUP"; mkdir "$BACKUP"; cp -a augen_blink_relief2/blink_*.png "$BACKUP/"; mkdir -p "$EVD"
WIN=$(DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool search --name 'FranKenstein -- live' | head -1); test -n "$WIN"
rollback(){ rc=$?; echo ROLLBACK=1 RC=$rc; cp -a "$BACKUP"/blink_*.png augen_blink_relief2/; DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool key --window "$WIN" ctrl+shift+r || true; sleep 2; exit $rc; }; trap rollback ERR
DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool windowactivate --sync "$WIN"; sleep 1; DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool key --window "$WIN" b; sleep 0.16; DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority import -window "$WIN" "$EVD/before-old-blink.png"
echo BEFORE_CAPTURE_SHA=$(sha256sum "$EVD/before-old-blink.png"|awk '{print $1}')
cp -a "$CAND"/blink/blink_*.png augen_blink_relief2/
echo LIVE_RELIEF2_NEW_HASHES; sha256sum augen_blink_relief2/blink_*.png | sort
for f in "$CAND"/blink/blink_*.png; do n=$(basename "$f"); c=$(sha256sum "$f"|awk '{print $1}'); d=$(sha256sum "augen_blink_relief2/$n"|awk '{print $1}'); h=$(curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:8788/augen_blink/$n"|sha256sum|awk '{print $1}'); test "$c" = "$d"; test "$c" = "$h"; done
echo ACTIVE_RELIEF2_HTTP_READBACK=PASS
DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool key --window "$WIN" ctrl+shift+r; sleep 3; DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool windowactivate --sync "$WIN"; DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority import -window "$WIN" "$EVD/after-idle.png"; DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool key --window "$WIN" b; sleep 0.16; DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority import -window "$WIN" "$EVD/after-eye-only-blink.png"
B=$(sha256sum "$EVD/before-old-blink.png"|awk '{print $1}'); A=$(sha256sum "$EVD/after-eye-only-blink.png"|awk '{print $1}'); I=$(sha256sum "$EVD/after-idle.png"|awk '{print $1}'); echo BEFORE=$B AFTER_IDLE=$I AFTER_BLINK=$A; test "$A" != "$I"
identify "$EVD/before-old-blink.png" "$EVD/after-idle.png" "$EVD/after-eye-only-blink.png"
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,time,urllib.request,statistics
xs=[]
for i in range(15):
 with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8788/api/status',timeout=3) as r:d=json.load(r)
 f=float((d.get('fps') or {}).get('fps')); xs.append(f); print('FPS',i,f); time.sleep(.5)
print('FPS_MEDIAN',statistics.median(xs),'FPS_MIN',min(xs),'FPS_MEAN',round(statistics.mean(xs),3)); assert statistics.median(xs)>=58
PY
test "$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service)" = active
test "$(ps -C chrome -o args= | grep chrome-profile | grep -c -- '--type=gpu-process' || true)" -ge 1
test -z "$(ps -C chrome -o args= | grep chrome-profile | grep -E -- '--disable-gpu($|[ =])|--disable-gpu-compositing($|[ =])|--disable-software-rasterizer($|[ =])' || true)"
echo BLINK_RELIEF2_LIVE_RUNTIME_GATE=PASS
trap - ERR
